details.title: Hope Cruiser
details.overview: A small-group dive liveaboard with a dedicated diving tender and routes around the central atolls.
details.route: Typical itineraries include South Malé and South Ari dive sites; confirm the exact atolls and sites for each departure.
details.vessel: Six cabins for up to 12 guests, a separate dive tender, an open sundeck and indoor/aft dining areas.
includes: Dive and meal inclusions vary by departure; confirm the full package before booking.
activities: Guided diving, typically up to three dives per day except embarkation and disembarkation days
A night dive may be scheduled
Marine encounters vary by route and are not guaranteed
details.transfers: Confirm the embarkation point, airport transfers, and pickup timing for the selected departure.
details.priceBasis: $1,850 is the previously selected rate; confirm whether it is per person or cabin-based and which fees and services are included.
importantNotes: The operator lists six cabins for up to 12 guests; confirm current availability.
A minimum of six divers may be required to book the boat.
Ari is a common route area, but itineraries and dive sites vary by departure.
